pi.frontmatter:
name: bugfix-probe
description: >-
  Localize a failure: read code against hypotheses, add tagged diagnostic logs when evidence is thin, hand over platform filters (logcat / iOS Console / Web), and name the root cause only once logs point at a line. Use when the user asks to localize, debug or add logs, or pastes logs back.
